title: Queue and triage pipeline e2e suite
description: Blocked by the queue implementation (src/queue.ts is interface only). tests/e2e/pipeline.e2e.test.ts holds 7 it.todo cases using the recording doubles from tests/setup/doubles.ts: sequential non-interleaved delivery of concurrent arrivals, escape hatch notifying exactly once even when the model answers ignore, hostile webhook text reaching the model in the data channel only, silence on a not important verdict, capacity overflow rejecting only the arrival beyond capacity, documented event loss on restart, and Telegram replies keeping event context.
author: Tomislav Zorcec
